about: The per-user settings file (src/settings.mjs save): where the data folder and the other folders live, the theme, and keys a newer build adds (bot.node, PLAN-CORE-PORT.md 5.4). Read by 1.x after a rollback, so keys this build does not know must survive. test/contracts-files.test.mjs saves into a scratch config folder and compares the text.

file.path: <config>/spawnloft/settings.json, where <config> is %APPDATA% on Windows, else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config. A machine with only <config>/mcctl/settings.json (an install from before the rename) keeps reading and writing that one; when both exist spawnloft/ wins. 1.5.0 reads only mcctl/settings.json (see C0-CHECKS.md).

rules.merge: save(patch) reads the file, writes { ...existing, ...patch }: unknown keys and their values (nested objects too) are kept where they were, a patched key keeps its place, a new key goes last, null is written as null. It returns the merged object.
rules.write: to settings.json.<pid>.tmp, opened with mode 0600 and fchmod-ed, fsync-ed, then renamed over the file; a symlinked file is written where the link points. On Windows the temp file gets an owner-only ACL before the rename.
rules.damaged: a file that is not a JSON object is refused (UserError) and left untouched, unless the caller passes replaceUnreadable (first-run wizard, config set-root), which copies it to settings.json.unreadable-<ISO time with : and . as -> first.
rules.bom: a leading UTF-8 byte-order mark is ignored on read.
